description: REQ-E2 + REQ-B3 collision-then-idempotent race leaves no plist loaded. Sequence: (1) a stale job is loaded from a DIFFERENT path (e.g. /tmp/old.plist); (2) the canonical disk plist $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.anicca.<slot>-proactive.plist already exists with the EXACT byte content that render_plist would produce (e.g. left over from a prior install that was then bootout'd). Run: line 55-61 parses path, sees it != canonical, calls bootout — the OLD job is unloaded. Then line 64-71 computes digests; existing file matches new content, so NEEDS_WRITE=0. The branch at line 73-88 is skipped entirely — there is no bootstrap call. Result: the script exits via REQ-C1 launchctl print at line 91, which will FAIL because we just bootout'd the job and never bootstrapped a replacement → exit 7 with stderr 'post-install launchctl print failed'. So the user-visible symptom is an install error AND no loaded job — but the disk plist is unchanged so a second run finally fixes it. REQ-B4 (idempotent = exactly one loaded job after N calls) is violated for N=1 in this specific cross-path-collision-plus-prior-disk-state. Fix: when bootout fires at line 59, set NEEDS_WRITE=1 unconditionally (or move the bootstrap call outside the NEEDS_WRITE guard when the loaded path differed from canonical).

evidence.snippet:
PRINT_OUT="$(launchctl print "gui/$UID_NUM/$LABEL" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -n "$PRINT_OUT" ]]; then
  EXISTING_PATH="$( cd "$SHARED_DIR" && printf '%s' "$PRINT_OUT" | "$PY" -m lib.plist_render parse-path 2>/dev/null || true )"
  if [[ -n "$EXISTING_PATH" && "$EXISTING_PATH" != "$PLIST" ]]; then
    launchctl bootout "gui/$UID_NUM/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi
# NEEDS_WRITE may be 0 → skips bootstrap entirely
